en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Yusuf Al Bazzaz, from Moalla Bin Khunays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one with the most intense of regrets on the Day of Judgment would be the one who portrayed the justice, then acted without it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Yusuf al- Bazzaz from Mu’alla ibn Khanis from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
One who, on the Day of Judgment, will regret the most is he who preaches justice but himself acts otherwise.”
